completed_commands.command:
/bin/sh -lc "cat /workspace/solution/dev_result.json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c \"import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('status:', d.get('status')); print('raw_metric:', d.get('raw_metric')); print('score:', d.get('score')); print('method_sha256:', d.get('method_sha256')[:16]+'...')\" 2>/dev/null || echo \"No valid result yet\"
stat -c '%Y %y' /workspace/solution/dev_result.json 2>/dev/null || echo \"No file\""
/bin/sh -lc 'ps aux | grep grader | grep -v grep; echo "---"; ls -la /workspace/solution/dev_result.pending.json 2>/dev/null || echo "No pending file"'

/bin/sh -lc 'cat /proc/5060/status 2>/dev/null | head -3 || echo "Process 5060 not found"
# Check if any python grader is running
ls /proc/*/cmdline 2>/dev/null | while read f; do
  cmd=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null | tr '"'\\0' ' ')
  echo \""'$cmd" | grep -q grader && echo "Found: $cmd" && echo "PID: $(basename $(dirname $f))"
done'
